subject: general
question: A car travels 60 km at 30 km/h, 90 km at 45 km/h, 150 km at z km/h. If average speed = 60 km/h, find z .
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Total distance = 60 + 90 + 150 = 300 km. Total time required for 60 km/h average speed = 300 ÷ 60 = 5 hours. Time consumed for first two parts = (60 ÷ 30) + (90 ÷ 45) = 2 + 2 = 4 hours. Remaining time for third part = 5 − 4 = 1 hour. Speed z = 150 km ÷ 1 hour = 150 km/h. **∴ The correct answer is 150 km/h.**
